name: Allium
description: Allium is a genus of flowering plants that includes onions, garlic, and chives.
careInstructions: Allium plants prefer well-drained soil and full sun exposure.

name: Alstroemeria
description: Alstroemeria, also known as Peruvian lily, is a genus of flowering plants native to South America.
careInstructions: Alstroemeria plants require regular watering and partial shade.

name: Alyssum
description: Alyssum is a genus of flowering plants in the family Brassicaceae, native to the Mediterranean region.
careInstructions: Alyssum plants prefer full sun and well-drained soil. They are drought-tolerant and low-maintenance.

name: Amaranthus
description: Amaranthus is a genus of annual or short-lived perennial plants known for their vibrant, showy flowers and edible leaves.
careInstructions: Amaranthus plants thrive in warm climates with well-drained soil. They require regular watering.

name: Anemone
description: Anemone is a genus of flowering plants in the family Ranunculaceae, known for its delicate and colorful flowers.
careInstructions: Anemone plants prefer moist, well-drained soil and partial shade. They are great for adding a pop of color to gardens.
